ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee (RydeX instant booking, rider cancelled after the 3-minute grace period). No refund due; no account flag.

rejected_claims.reason: Chat and driver statement say 5 min away; regardless, NS-4/NS-8 provide no free-cancellation right for driver distance or lateness — the stated reason for the refund fails, even though the timing of the cancellation does support it.
Confirmed by GPS (driver ~1.7 km north on Boon Lay Way at cancellation, moving away from the Jurong East pickup), but irrelevant to NS-4, which turns solely on the matched-to-cancel interval.
